Title: Y Offset Positions
Description: For each input position, samples the Density field at that point and adds Multiplier × field value to Y, then keeps the point only if it still lies in the original bounds. The child positions provider sees the vertical bounds expanded by |Multiplier| (assuming the field stays within about [-1, 1]), matching stock Jitter3d behavior so PCN and similar sources are not starved of candidates after the offset.

Options.Label: Multiplier
Options.Description: Scaled density is added to Y: y += Multiplier × density(position).

Outputs.Label: Positions
Outputs.Description: Child positions provider (e.g. grid or Deterministic Random).

Outputs.Label: FieldFunction
Outputs.Description: Density evaluated at each emitted position (e.g. SimplexNoise2D).
